description: Analysis snapshots for historical tracking, one tool, three actions: "save" (run analyses and store under .dendro/snapshots/ — requires entryFile), "list" (metadata for every saved snapshot), "compare" (diff two snapshots or a snapshot vs "current" live analysis — requires base and target; entryFile required when either side is "current"). Typical loop: save before a refactor, compare base:"<id>" target:"current" after.

analyses.description: save: which analyses to include. Default: ["tree", "complexity", "context"]

entryFile.description: save: entry file to analyze (required). compare: required when base or target is "current".

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the workspace root directory

name: manage_snapshots
